description: This Python source file contains functions and classes for extracting, parsing, and transforming recipe data from web scrapers and YouTube videos, including handling of images, instructions, keywords, and recipe properties, with integrations to Django models and utilities.

classes.name: AutomationEngine
classes.description: A helper class for applying automation rules to recipe data.

classes.name: IngredientParser
classes.description: A class for parsing ingredient strings into structured data.

methods.name: get_from_scraper
methods.description: Extracts recipe data from a scraper object and request, returning a structured JSON.

methods.name: get_from_youtube_scraper
methods.description: Extracts recipe data from a YouTube video URL.

methods.name: parse_name
methods.description: Normalizes and extracts the recipe name from various input formats.

methods.name: clean_instruction_string
methods.description: Cleans and normalizes instruction strings, handling HTML tags and special characters.

methods.name: parse_instructions
methods.description: Converts various instruction formats into a flat list of instruction strings.

methods.name: parse_image
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes image URLs from different formats.

methods.name: parse_servings
methods.description: Parses servings information from strings or lists into an integer.

methods.name: parse_servings_text
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes servings text description.

methods.name: parse_time
methods.description: Converts recipe time data into minutes.

methods.name: parse_keywords
methods.description: Processes and applies automation to keywords extracted from recipe data.

methods.name: listify_keywords
methods.description: Converts keyword strings or lists into a list of trimmed keywords.

methods.name: normalize_string
methods.description: Removes HTML tags and normalizes whitespace in strings.

methods.name: iso_duration_to_minutes
methods.description: Converts ISO 8601 duration strings to minutes.

methods.name: get_images_from_soup
methods.description: Extracts image URLs from HTML soup object.

methods.name: clean_dict
methods.description: Recursively removes specified keys from nested dictionaries.
